incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A flooded street with buildings partially submerged in brown water, under an overcast sky.

observations.description: Brown, murky water covering the street and reaching up to the lower levels of buildings.
Multiple multi-story buildings with traditional European architecture, some with arched doorways and windows.
Street signs including a red stop sign and a blue direction sign, partially submerged.
A street lamp and a small white object (possibly a bag) floating in the water near the left building.
